title: Evaluation of Postoperative Well-Being and Patient Satisfaction Following Minimally Invasive Coronary Artery Bypass Surgery Using the Anesthesiology Follow-Up Questionnaire (ANP-KA)
summary: The aim of the planned study is to identify and describe the symptoms patients experience following TCRAT, how these symptoms evolve over time, and how satisfied patients are with their perioperative care. This will be followed by a comparison with data from open surgical procedures involving sternotomy, with regard to the recorded outcomes.

interventions.name: Elective coronary artery bypass surgery/semi-elective coronary artery bypass surgery with marked urgency (N6, N12, N24, N48–72) using TCRAT, performed at Fulda Hospital, followed by transfer to the intensive care unit.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Signed consent to participate in the study
-Consent to anesthetic procedures following a pre-procedure consultation
Exclusion criteria:
-Refusal to participate
-Patients unable to provide informed consent
-Combined surgeries or intraoperative switch to full sternotomy
-Insufficient command of the German language
-Form received but not completed
-Patients in poor health who are unable to participate, even with assistance
  - Ongoing mechanical ventilation
  - Ongoing severe cognitive impairment
